name: Love≠Stalker?
source:
Tanaka Hanako is a junior in high school who really wants a boyfriend. One day, she meets three guys.
What would you have done to get someone you like to notice you...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/137]Freem![/url]]
translation:
田中花子是一名高中生，非常想要一个男朋友。有一天，她遇到了三个男人。
为了让你喜欢的人注意到你，你会做什么……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/137]Freem![/url]]
